property_summary: For any non-empty _tos list and any callee address that implements transferFrom(address,address,uint256) correctly, C.transfer(...) always returns true (call succeeds for every element) — the mutant that uses an incorrect selector will cause the external call to the callee to fail (revert or return false) for some inputs (a callee that only implements the correct selector), so the reference returns true but the mutant reverts/returns false.
change_summary: Change bytes4 selector computation to an incorrect selector so the external call will likely revert (mismatch) while original succeeded.
